pattern: なくて済む（なくてすむ）
purpose: Say that an otherwise necessary action can be avoided.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
There is a digital version, so we do not need to print it.
A friend came to collect me, so I did not have to call a taxi.
If you contact us early, you will not have to queue.
restrictions: Often expresses relief at avoiding effort, cost, or trouble.
mistake: 済む describes the situation being resolved without the action.

segments.role: Say that an otherwise necessary action can be avoided. Vなくて + 済む
